svg.title: Inventory N0 — all 21 transitions
svg.desc: Each panel is an exact transition star. Repeated place labels denote the same place across panels. Solid incoming arcs consume, dashed incoming arcs read, outgoing arcs produce.
svg.text: Repeated place labels denote the same place. Dashed input = read. All arc multiplicities shown.
Blue: domain · green: activation · amber: runtime · violet: adapter. Source: Inventory.weave (N0).
